ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes and 30% low-intensity black pixels localized at the margins and median notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad white interior regions (medial) surrounded by a continuous black perimeter (distal and trailing edge); heavy black mottling and streaking radiating from the median notch toward the central white fields; scattered small-scale black spots across the high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a depth roughly 1/6th the height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; image-left lobe exhibits deeper, jagged macro-valleys and pointed peaks; image-right lobe shows more uniform micro-serrations with a notable indentation near the lateral tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slight concavity before reaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of white, high-contrast circular pixel structures consistent with barnacle colonization located on the extreme distal tips of both lobes and sparsely along the leading edge margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) ranging from short diagonal streaks in the image-left medial region to longer, vertical-parallel lines near the image-right center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue indentations on the trailing edge of the image-left lobe; heavy parasitic/calcified clusters on both lateral fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, dark circular ring-like mark located in the lower-middle quadrant of the image-right lobe.
